selection: Diagnostic states selected after inspecting previous results; this is exploratory analysis, not a new held-out benchmark. The local and mirrored pre-block states are each reconstructed with one legal prefix action; the other four states are initial A decisions after B moves.
history: Fresh single-observation requests in both conditions. No historical model completions supplied. Prompt turn number restarts at one; environment round and remaining actions stay accurate.
review: Manually label factual correctness, rationale/action agreement, and quality of strategic justification. Missing rationale is not assessable, not a fabricated explanation.
scope: Only inference. No retraining, no full episodes, no primary evaluation overwrite. A rationale prompt changes model behavior and cannot reveal the cause of an earlier action-only decision.
